title: TreeAI D2 verification environment record
description: Shape of environment.json under evidence/d2/runs/<run-id>/. Records the exact toolchain baseline and the credential policy of the run. The Pi pinned version is CONSTRAINED to the exact literal 0.85.1 (ADR-001 / D1 DECISION-003): latest, ranges and unrecorded heads are rejected. installedVersion is free-form so that an environment drift can still be RECORDED honestly and flagged by a verifier check (schema validity must never force anyone to hide a mismatch). Credential policy values: offline = no credentials exist in this run by design (verify:d2); controlled-env-injection = live credentials were supplied exclusively via controlled environment variables, used only in memory and never persisted or logged (verify:d2:live); none = live was requested but no credentials were available (the run must report BLOCKED, exit 3). This record must not contain credential values, absolute user-home paths or machine-identifying secrets. Revision policy: breaking changes require a schemas/d2/README.md revision entry and new probes under tests/fixtures/schema-probes/environment/.

driver.description: Live runs only: runtime driver (pi | fake).

pinnedVersion.description: The D2 pinned Pi version. Hard schema constraint; changing it is a breaking schema revision AND requires an approved Pi version upgrade record (D1 DECISION-003).

installedVersion.description: Actually installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent version (from node_modules), or null when not installed. A value different from pinnedVersion is schema-valid (recorded honestly) but must FAIL the verifier's pi-version-pin check.

source.description: Where installedVersion was read from (relative path only).

note.description: Redacted note (e.g. which env var NAMES gate the live mode; never values).
